Delta-only disposition

Reviewed only the complete delta between the full base/head above: crates/daemon/src/community/root.rs and docs/how/pa-watchdog.md. The security source inspection was delegated once; this role holder independently verified finality and the successful CI attempt's named JUnit outcomes. Retained file-and-line evidence was obtained before publication. No security blocker or outside-account vulnerability was established under C33.

- root.rs:209-225 canonicalizes the existing start before ancestor discovery. A canonicalization failure or non-NotFound .git metadata error returns Unknown. The initial is_dir guard is unchanged; the delta does not make every possible initial metadata failure an Unknown. Repo outputs remain canonicalized (root.rs:229,250,300-301), and the unchanged shim uses the shared common_dir (http/shim.rs:129-133). No new shell, credential disclosure, logging sink or authority change appears in this delta.
- root.rs:198,260-270 sets POINTER_CAP to 4096, rejects nonregular or oversized metadata before opening, reads through take(4097), and accepts only strings of at most 4096 bytes. Thus ordinary stable FIFOs and oversized files are not opened by this helper; growth beyond the cap observed during reading is rejected. Open/read/UTF-8 errors fail the helper. Both .git and commondir use this helper (root.rs:234-247); invalid or empty text becomes Unknown, and only a missing commondir selects the gitdir itself.
- root.rs:435-491 contains the Git-comparison regression for aliases inside repository A and outside every repository, both resolving to repository B. root.rs:515-557 contains missing/plain-folder, malformed/non-UTF-8/dangling-pointer and FIFO/oversized cases for both pointer locations. The mkfifo helper at root.rs:497-502 is test-only. Source was inspected; none of these tests or fixtures was executed locally.
- The entire changed documentation paragraph (docs/how/pa-watchdog.md:114) contains generic behavior, limits, fallback and cost text; no identified credentials, personal filesystem paths or new data-collection instructions. No dependency, lockfile, workflow or push change is in this delta.

The round-one unbounded/special-file-read note is CLOSED for ordinary stable metadata. Canonicalizing the start addresses the alias-placement mechanism behind R248-1 within this security inspection; the correctness role owns its independent correctness verdict.

C34 follow-up, nonblocking: qualify any absolute "never blocks" wording. The guard bounds bytes, not elapsed time. The existing metadata/open separation (root.rs:217,241,260-268) does not establish race-free descriptor identity, and Unknown may still invoke the existing Git fallback. No outside-account exploitation path or normal-use regression was established; additional race hardening is not a security gate under C33/C34.
